MDY was vulnerable to suit because Blizzard argued (successfully) that it devalued services that customers were paying for. I don't pay for advertisements, which are the services affected by ad blockers, nor do I pay for the content delivery, which is not /directly/ affected by ad blockers, and therefore has no grounds to bring suit (they have no injury from my use of the software).
